rules:
The first line of the input contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100 000) — length of the strip.

Next line contains a string of length n which consists of characters "<" and ">" only, that provide the direction of the jump from the corresponding cell. Next line contains n integers di (1 ≤ di ≤ 109) — the length of the jump from the i-th cell. Unique token result under retained description; generated qualification and independent oracle/audit outstanding.
